newsitem.title: USA: Clinton calls Rabin's widow one year after killing.
newsitem.headline: Clinton calls Rabin's widow one year after killing.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton telephoned the widow of assassinated Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin on Thursday to tell her she was in his thoughts on the first anniversary of Rabin's murder, a White House spokesman said.
Clinton placed the call from his official aircraft, Airforce One, during a flight from Washington to Alabama as he campaigned for the Nov. 5 presidential election.
The call lasted about five minutes, spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.
"He wished her well and said he was thinking about her," McCurry said.
He said the president had videotaped a salute to Rabin that was used as part of anniversary tributes in Israel.
